watch.h: Trump-Xi Summit and Potential Tariff Reductions
watch.why: Around November 25. The upcoming summit between Trump and Xi is expected to focus on major tariff reductions and US soybean exports.

idea.why: Monitor the specific tariff exemptions and refund claims filed by major retailers like Target to identify which supply chains are currently protected from new levies. Target recently booked $301 million in refunds, proving that immediate financial relief is available for compliant suppliers, whereas competitors facing unannounced tariffs will see margin compression similar to Lowe's.
